play.definition: A downhill gap-scheme run built around play-side down blocks, a backside guard pulling across the formation to lead through the point of attack, and an edge blocker kicking out or sealing the force defender. The down blocks and kick-out block create a structured inside-out running lane, typically through the play-side B-gap or C-gap. The running back takes a downhill track, follows the pulling guard, and makes a decisive cut inside or outside the kick-out block based on defender leverage. Base Power normally uses one puller, most commonly the backside guard, and is not defined by coordinated lateral zone movement or multiple vertical double teams across the entire offensive line.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
